item.title: Team Spirit уступила Xtreme Gaming и покинула BLAST Slam IX по Dota 2
item.description: Team Spirit завершила выступление на онлайн-турнире BLAST Slam IX по Dota 2, уступив китайской Xtreme Gaming в матче на вылет со счётом 1:2.

item.title: France reach Nations Championship final with bonus-point Argentina win
item.description: France reached the Nations Championship final after beating Argentina 45-17 with seven tries on Saturday.

item.title: MVG still a force to be reckoned with ahead of Grand Slam semi-finals
item.description: Michael van Gerwen has shown he is still a force to be reckoned with as he prepares to face fellow Dutchman Gian van Veen in his first major semi-final in over a year.

item.title: London City keep up title hunt with emphatic win over Crystal Palace
item.description: London City Lionesses stay in the hunt for the Women's Super League title, with a statement second-half performance to give them a 6-2 win over Crystal Palace.
